technology_name: Testing and Calibration Services for Instruments, Food, Water & Materials
institution: KSCSTE - Sophisticated Test and Instrumentation Centre (STIC)
problem_solved: The lack of accessible, high-end analytical equipment and NABL-accredited calibration services for regional manufacturing, academic research, and public health sectors.
description: A comprehensive analytical and calibration service hub. STIC operates a DST-supported Sophisticated Analytical Instrument Facility (SAIF) alongside NABL-accredited electro-technical, thermal, and mechanical calibration labs. Furthermore, it houses dedicated KSCSTE-supported food and water testing labs. Beyond raw testing, the center offers active capacity-building training programs and highly specialized technical consultancy for aerospace and defense technologies.
applications:
• Industrial quality control and manufacturing equipment calibration

• Public health compliance for municipal water and commercial food products

• Corporate R&D and academic research material analysis

• Technical consultancy and part-testing for aerospace/defense contractors
